name: Lewis Swan
milestones: Married Mary Adams (m. 1848) after Magdalena's death
sources: Further Research on the Family and Descendants of Joseph P. and Elizabeth (Hamilton) Adams, William W. Allen (February 2012)
Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, compiled by William W. "Bill" Allen (2 April 2011 edition)
notes: Married Magdalena Adams (m. 25 Sep 1838) then Mary Adams (Swan) (m. 24 Sep 1848) after Magdalena's death.
Spent the rest of his life moving between his children's households and the Gills' [Bill Allen, Further Research, 2012, line 8478]
Bill Allen’s hypothesis: Bill believes Lewis, much older than Magdalena, had an earlier marriage that produced Horatio and Melissa. [Bill Allen, line 8463]
Bill Allen’s hypothesis: No death or burial record found; assumed to have died between 1870 and 1880. [Bill Allen, line 8520]
